response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') AS rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')), o AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS overall_avg FROM signals WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL), q AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_modindex, g.avg_modindex - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM g CROSS JOIN o WHERE g.avg_modindex > o.overall_avg) SELECT rfistat, avg_modindex, diff_from_overall, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM q) AS diff_from_qualifying_mean FROM q
